Requirement: "No renames or removals of existing identifiers, env vars, labels, markers or log prefixes (CLAUDE.md §6 / unattended §10)" and the implementer discipline "Edit only the paths in this issue's `files_touched`". The `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` symlink to `../CLAUDE.md` is a tracked file that downstream consumers copy via `update_workflows.yml` and that two contract tests assert against.
Expected change site: `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` (must remain a symlink (mode 120000) to `../CLAUDE.md`).
Evidence of absence: The PR diff deletes this file (`deleted file mode 120000`, previous content `../CLAUDE.md`). `glob` for `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` in the current checkout returns no files. `tests/test_claude_md_section_numbers.py:36` asserts `(ROOT / "workflow-templates" / "CLAUDE.md").resolve() == CLAUDE_MD.resolve()` and will fail because the path does not exist. `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:2209` calls `TEMPLATE_CLAUDE_MD.read_text(encoding="utf-8")` and will raise `FileNotFoundError`. The LAST RUN DIFF (which touches only the changelog fragment, `scripts/activation_verify.sh`, and `tests/test_claude_engine_utility_roles.py`) does not restore the symlink, so the failure persists at the current head SHA. Both AI autofix editor summaries in the PR comments acknowledge the deletion and explain that the editor sandbox cannot restore it (`unsafe_file` from result transfer); recovery requires `git checkout <base> -- workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` from a process that can write the symlink.
SEVERITY: BLOCKER
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
